raw.description:
Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare, we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.

The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.

We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.

Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit.

Summary:

The Senior Director, Finance serves as a senior financial advisor and fractional/interim CFO-level resource, providing strategic financial leadership, operational oversight, and executive-level counsel. The role partners with executive leadership to strengthen financial performance, cash flow, forecasting, budgeting, capital planning, financial controls, and long-term sustainability. The Finance Consultant evaluates financial and operational results, identifies risks and opportunities, develops actionable recommendations, and helps lead financial initiatives that support organizational strategy and informed decision-making.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a strategic financial advisor to executive leadership, providing CFO-level guidance on financial performance, organizational priorities, growth opportunities, risk, and long-term financial sustainability.

  • Lead the preparation, review, and analysis of internal and external financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), ensuring accurate and timely reporting of financial results.

  • Develop and oversee annual operating and capital budgets, long-range financial plans, rolling forecasts, and financial models. Analyze performance against budget and forecast and recommend corrective actions when needed.

  • Evaluate revenue, expense, margin, productivity, and service-line performance; identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities; and provide actionable recommendations to leadership.

  • Oversee cash flow and liquidity planning, including cash forecasting, banking relationships, debt obligations, working capital, and investment performance. Recommend strategies to optimize liquidity and financial returns.

  • Advise leadership on capital allocation and major financial commitments. Develop business cases, return-on-investment analyses, sensitivity analyses, and financial projections for strategic initiatives and capital expenditures.

  • Assess the effectiveness of financial systems, reporting tools, accounting processes, and internal controls. Recommend and lead improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, transparency, and scalability.

  • Provide executive oversight and guidance for accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, payroll, financial reporting, reconciliations, and related financial controls.

  • Provide strategic oversight of reimbursement and payer-related financial matters, including Medicare, Medicaid, and other payer cost reporting, reimbursement analysis, regulatory reporting, and coordination with external consultants as appropriate.

  • Partner with operational leaders to improve financial literacy, establish meaningful financial and operational metrics, and strengthen accountability for budget and performance results.

  • Lead or coordinate annual financial audits and other external reviews. Serve as a primary financial liaison with independent auditors, actuaries, tax advisors, banks, consultants, and other external financial partners.

  • Ensure appropriate oversight of federal, state, and local financial and tax reporting requirements, including applicable payroll and information reporting obligations.

  • Evaluate financial policies, procedures, and internal controls and recommend updates to support compliance, safeguard assets, reduce risk, and promote sound financial governance.

  • Support executive and board reporting by preparing concise financial presentations, dashboards, forecasts, and recommendations that clearly communicate organizational financial position and performance.

  • Provide financial due diligence and integration support for acquisitions, affiliations, new service lines, restructuring, or other strategic transactions, as requested.

  • Coach and develop finance leaders and staff, clarify roles and accountabilities, and recommend organizational structure or staffing changes needed to strengthen the finance function.

  • Assist with turnaround, stabilization, cost-reduction, revenue enhancement, and performance-improvement initiatives when financial or operational results require intervention.

  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound professional judgment when handling sensitive financial, strategic, employee, and organizational information.

  • Perform other CFO-level financial consulting and strategic assignments as requested.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Executive-level financial acumen with the ability to connect financial results to operational and strategic decisions.

  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, internal controls, audit coordination, and financial analysis.

  • Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to executives, board members, operational leaders, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, judgment, and problem-solving skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify financial risk and develop practical, sustainable solutions.

  • Ability to influence and advise leaders while maintaining an objective, consultative approach.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives and meet established deadlines.

  • Commitment to collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, service excellence, and ethical financial practices.

  • Advanced proficiency with financial systems, spreadsheets, reporting platforms, and business intelligence tools.

Work Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required. Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline preferred.

  • CPA, CMA, or other advanced financial credential preferred.

  • 7-10 years of progressively responsible financial leadership experience, including senior finance, controller, VP Finance, or CFO-level responsibilities. Healthcare finance experience is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to advise executive teams and boards, lead financial strategy, manage complex financial operations, and translate financial information into clear business recommendations.

Working Conditions:

  • Work from home and remote location with a stable internet connection, a quiet and dedicated workspace free of distractions, and access to necessary office equipment. The ability to have daily communication with team members, management, and clients through email, phone calls, video meetings and other collaborative tools. Primarily requires sitting at a desk for extended period. Proper lighting and ergonomics shole be maintained to reduce eye strain.

  • Primarily works in a professional office, remote, or client-site environment, depending on the consulting engagement.

  • May be subject to frequent interruptions, competing priorities, and time-sensitive financial deadlines.

  • Generally a sedentary position with regular use of a computer and other office technology.

  • Must be able to work the hours necessary to complete critical projects, financial reporting, audits, and executive deliverables within established time requirements.

  • Travel may be required based on the needs of the consulting engagement.

  • The position requires the ability to perform the essential functions of a senior financial consulting role, with or without reasonable accommodation. Requirements include prolonged sitting; frequent computer and keyboard use; reading and interpreting detailed financial information; effective verbal and written communication; sustained concentration; analytical thinking; memory; attention to detail; sound judgment; and decision-making. Occasional standing, walking, reaching, and lifting of typical office materials may be required.

raw.description:
Are you excited to lead a high-performing organization at the intersection of content, technology, and customer value?

Can you transform global editorial operations while advancing the future of AI-enabled legal workflows?

About our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX ( a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles.

About the Role

The Global Head of Analytical Editorial Operations sets the global strategy for how LexisNexis' secondary content portfolio is developed, maintained, and activated as a competitive asset, accountable for its authority, currency, structure, and demonstrated value in customer workflows and AI-generated answers, and for the operating model that sustains it.

Secondary content is a key differentiator in the legal market, offering expert analysis, commentary, and guidance that becomes the basis on which customers judge whether an answer can be trusted and acted on. This role is accountable for making that differentiation real and measurable in the products customers use.

You will be accountable for galvanizing a global team under a common growth and operating north star, and ultimately drive improvements in operational efficiency, revenue, margin, customer satisfaction, and answer-set quality in Protégé.

The role will set the vision and operating model for GenAI-enabled Analytical content, including the Agentic Content Platform (ACP) and GenAI-augmented content updating. The incumbent will ensure these capabilities are adopted responsibly and at scale to keep content current, structured, trusted, and increasingly valuable in customer workflows.

You will also play an integral role in driving employee engagement and enabling high performance across the organization. The incumbent innovates to globalize tools, systems, and processes; sets organizational priorities; drives automation; and is responsible for implementing global policies, metrics, and strategies across Analytical Editorial Operations.

Incumbent has full responsibility for management of Editorial and Operations teams aligned with Analytical (secondary) content, with emphasis on operational efficiency, high quality editorial judgment, and promotion of organizational values and culture.

The incumbent will partner with Segments, Product, Technology, and relevant commercial stakeholders to create new global Analytical content opportunities; improve the quality, relevance, and completeness of answer sets in Protégé, and ensure delivery of the enhancements, product features, and functions each market requires.

Role may be based anywhere in Asia and Pacific (Australia, Hong Kong, India, Malaysia, New Zealand,) North America (US and Canada), or the UK.

The Global Head of Analytical Editorial Operations reports to the Senior Vice President of Global Editorial Operations.

Responsibilities

  • Set the global strategy, operating roadmap, and priorities for Analytical Editorial Operations, ensuring consistent execution across a 150-person organization spanning Asia, North America, Pacific, and the UK

  • Partner with Segments, Product, GTO, Data Science, Product Operations, and commercial leaders to improve the creation, delivery, and activation of global Analytical products

  • Lead the global adoption and scaling of GenAI-enabled Analytical content capabilities, including the Agentic Content Platform, ACE, and GenAI-augmented content updating

  • Transform Analytical content workflows to improve content currency, structure, discoverability, and operational efficiency while maintaining rigorous editorial quality and customer trust

  • Prioritize content and workflow investments that improve the quality, relevance, completeness, and trustworthiness of answer sets in Protégé

  • Own author and expert relationships for the Analytical portfolio, including recruitment and retention in partnership with Commercial, and the editorial standards that sustain external authority

  • Establish global standards, governance, performance measures, and appropriate human-in-the-loop controls for GenAI-enabled editorial workflows, including quality assurance, content risk management, and escalation mechanisms

  • Use customer feedback, editorial outcomes, usage data, and operational metrics to drive data-informed decisions and continuous improvement in content quality, customer experience, and operating performance

  • Provide strategic insight, clear performance reporting, and recommendations on content systems, operating models, and global best practices to the SVP, Global Editorial Operations

  • Lead global planning, resource allocation, and financial management for the Analytical organization, including budget management, cost projections, and investment priorities

  • Build a high-performing, future-ready global workforce through talent development, reskilling, recruitment, change leadership, and global adoption of proven tools, processes, and best practices

  • Set and execute the global strategy and operating roadmap for GenAI-enabled Analytical content, including the Agentic Content Platform, ACE, and GenAI-augmented content updating

Requirements

  • At least 10 years’ experience leading a global operation at scale, including accountability for delivery, quality, and financial performance

  • Experience supporting and interacting with diverse and high-level P&L stakeholders

  • Experience managing budgets

  • Experience leading through organizational transformation

  • Strong process, engineering and systems orientation

  • Experience operating global delivery models and managing vendor partnerships at scale

  • Demonstrated experience leading AI, GenAI, automation, or other technology-enabled business transformation initiatives from strategy through scaled operational adoption

  • Experience partnering with Product, Technology, Data Science, commercial, and operational teams to deliver customer-facing AI or digital-product outcomes

  • Experience applying data, customer feedback, and quality measures to improve content, search, retrieval, or AI-generated answer experiences

  • Legal-content, secondary-content, publishing, or information-services experience strongly preferred

  • BA/BS + JD, MBA, other advanced degree or equivalent experience required

  • Commercial fluency to make the case for content investments in revenue, retention, and product performance terms with Segments, Product, and Finance leadership

  • Collaborative management style with ability to lead global cross-functional, team-based, deadline-intensive strategic initiatives and delivery

  • Ability to build empirical cases linking content quality and coverage to product and customer outcomes, using retrieval performance, usage behavior, and customer research

  • Excellent organization/project planning, time management, change management across multiple functional groups and departments, and delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various costs, size and complexity

  • Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions, identifying risks/impacts and to facilitate management decision making

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills applicable to a wide audience including senior and executive management, customers, etc., including presenting information in a concise and effective manner to various departments

  • Drive strategic projects, working cross-functionally to structure problems, analyze opportunities, and develop solutions and actionable recommendations and results through a rigorous, data-driven process

  • Develop change management plans and drive business transformation efforts

  • Gather and analyze data, formulate and test hypotheses, synthesize findings, develop go-forward plans and help drive and translate recommendations into results

  • Motivate and inspire direct organization and peers

  • Ability to influence others to work collectively toward short- and long-term goals

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows

Crystalia Glass LLC is a U.S.-based manufacturer and provider of premium custom glass solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. For more than 9 years, we have operated as a full-cycle company, managing every stage of the process—from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation. With production facilities in both the United States and Europe, we deliver high-quality solutions to customers across the U.S.

As our business continues to grow, we are expanding our Supply Engineering team and are looking for an experienced Supply Engineering Team Lead to help scale our operations, optimize supply processes, and lead a high-performing team.

The Role

The Supply Engineering Team Lead will report directly to the Chief Technical Officer and lead a team of four Supply Engineers.

Approximately 80% of the role focuses on team leadership, coordination, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration, while 20% involves hands-on supply engineering activities to support the team during peak workload, employee absences, or complex projects.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring efficient procurement operations, developing internal processes, and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Please note: previous professional experience working with the US market is required for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on procurement/sourcing experience involving US-based suppliers and international markets.

Responsibilities

1. Procurement operations

  • Launch production by coordinating glass orders and ensuring the availability of required hardware and materials.
  • Plan inventory levels and forecast procurement needs.
  • Review technical drawings and specifications to prepare accurate material lists.
  • Verify dimensions, finishes, and quality requirements before placing orders.
  • Track engineering documentation and procurement changes throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure procurement documentation and component orders are completed before production and container arrivals.

2. Supplier management

  • Source, evaluate, and develop relationships with suppliers across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules.
  • Manage purchasing activities for production, warehouse, and installation operations.
  • Monitor supplier performance and resolve quality, logistics, and delivery issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, supplier performance, and cost optimization.

3. Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Project Managers, Engineers, Estimators, Warehouse, and Installation teams.
  • Support engineering changes, material substitutions, and procurement planning.
  • Provide procurement expertise, material recommendations, and pricing information for projects.
  • Ensure purchased materials meet project specifications and technical documentation.

4. Team leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four Supply Engineers.
  • Assign tasks, prioritize workloads, and monitor project deadlines.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and provide coaching and performance feedback.
  • Review procurement documentation, material lists, and purchase orders prepared by the team.
  • Support engineers with complex sourcing challenges and supplier escalations.
  • Coordinate procurement activities with internal stakeholders across departments.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and optimize procurement workflows.
  • Report progress, risks, and operational updates to the Chief Technical Officer.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Procurement Engineer, Supply Engineer, or in a similar engineering procurement role on the US market.
  • Previous people management or team leadership experience.
  • Experience working with suppliers across international markets, including the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Experience with procurement, sourcing, and import/export of engineering or production materials.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and engineering documentation.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and PDF tools.
  • Experience working with task management systems such as ClickUp or similar.
  • Fluent English is a must.
  • Fluent Russian will be a plus.

Personal qualities

  • Confident and proactive leader.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Work Location

  • Remote or On-site
  • Monday–Friday.
  • Working hours: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Paid Time Off:
    1. 5 paid vacation days during the first year.
    2. 15 paid vacation days annually starting from the second year.
    3. Paid Sick Leave: 5 days per year.
    4. Protected Time Off: 32 hours per year.

Why Join Crystalia Glass

  • Join a growing U.S.-based company with 9 years of experience delivering custom glass solutions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects.
  • Take ownership of a key operational function and help shape procurement processes as the company continues to scale.
  • Lead a talented Supply Engineering team and make a direct impact on efficiency, collaboration, and business growth.
  • Work closely with executive leadership and have the opportunity to influence decisions and process improvements.
  • Be part of a full-cycle company managing everything from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation.
  • Work on complex, high-quality custom projects for customers across the United States.
  • Collaborate with an international team and build relationships with suppliers across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
  • Grow professionally in a fast-paced environment where your expertise and ideas can make a real difference.

The Sr. Manager, Strategic Workforce Planning & Workforce Intelligence serves as a strategic advisor to HR and business leaders, translating business strategy into workforce decisions. This role leads enterprise workforce planning, scenario modeling, skills-based planning, and workforce intelligence initiatives that help leaders anticipate talent needs, identify workforce risks, and make informed investment decisions.

The position partners closely with Finance, HR, and business leadership to align workforce plans with business priorities while leveraging advanced analytics, AI-enabled insights, and workforce intelligence to improve organizational effectiveness.

You will be responsible for all aspects of managing strategic workforce planning & advanced analytics programs and data visualizations from conception through business integration. This includes gathering stakeholder input from program design to execution/integration, supporting data-architecture, effective planning, excellent communication between stakeholders and internal/external partners, ongoing program assessment and guidance.

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 6+ years of experience and professional achievements. The ideal candidate must have an inherent passion for data and data driven thinking and be adept at extracting patterns from volumes of data to drive strategy and operational efficiencies.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

  • The Sr Manager of Strategic Workforce Planning and Analytics is accountable for providing direction over workforce planning, future headcount forecasts, and analysis.
  • In partnership with finance, and global leadership, coordinate the annual global workforce planning process along with facilitating quarterly forecasts.
  • Translate workforce data into actionable business recommendations, scenario models, and strategic workforce strategies that influence hiring, organization design, capability investments, and operating decisions.
  • Perform workforce planning analytics using data gathered from planning systems and external benchmark datasets.
  • Conduct strategic mapping exercise and talent gap assessments to determine current/future talent needs through labor market assessments with a focus on the overall talent availability.
  • Develop and analyze reports and dashboard to track headcount planning along with organizing large amounts of data, build analytic models and tools, and perform strategic analysis (e.g. descriptive statistics, segmentation, trend analysis, forecasting, etc.)
  • Communicates to senior leaders any adjustments to workforce requirements based on updates to the forecasts.
  • Manage the development of data visualization solutions to cater to the needs of the business and target audience.
  • Consult and collaborate with leaders to understand key value drivers and challenges within their business units and determine the key metrics and insights that can help improve performance as a result.
  • Develop the story that accompanies all analyses: present, explain and discuss results of analyses concisely and effectively to drive fact-based decision making at all levels within the organization.

The experience that will set you up for success

  • 6+ years of professional experience
  • 4+ years of experience in managing workforce planning and/or analytics programs in partnership and collaboration with business leaders.
  • 3+ years of people analytics experience as part or a Human Resources function.
  • BA/BS or MS in a quantitative field preferred (statistics, operations research, mathematics, computer science, economics, analytics)
  • Platform proficiency/knowledge: Workday, Tableau, Power BI, etc.
  • Highly analytical, self-motivated, creative out-of-the-box thinker and desire for continuous learning in job-related subject matter.
  • Expertise in statistical modeling and advanced analytical methodology.
  • Subscribes to the highest standards of ethics and business/personal integrity.
  • Ability to manage sensitive employee information in a highly confidential manner.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and effectively manage a heavy workload.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to educate and influence management and senior leaders to act in a desired manner through written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to analyze, interpret, synthesize, and communicate complex information to non-technical audiences in a logical and concise manner.
  • Strong leadership traits, and ability to operate with great latitude and resourcefulness.

This can be a remote position but most of this team is in North Carolina. We prefer this person to be within an hour and a half from our core location in Greensboro, NC or Global Headquarters in Denver, CO.

Hiring Range:

$112,000.00 USD - $140,000.00 USD annually

Incentive Potential: This position is eligible for additional compensation awards that may include an annual incentive plan, sales incentive, or commission potential. Specific details of the additional compensation eligibility for this position will be provided during the recruiting and interview process.

Benefits at VF Corporation: You can review a general overview of each benefit program offered, including this year's medical plan rates on www.MyVFbenefits.com and by clicking Looking to Join VF? Detailed information on your benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

Please note, our hiring ranges are determined and built from market pay data. In determining the specific compensation for this position, we comply with all local, state, and federal laws.

At VF, we value a diverse, inclusive workforce and we provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to an individual’s race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. If you require accommodations during the application process, please contact us at . VF will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals to the extent required by applicable law.

Job Description

Contracts Manager

Job Description

Overview:

Under the general leadership of the Director of Contracts, the Contracts Manager is responsible for overseeing the contract lifecycle of business service contracts and supervising the activity of all contract subordinates.

Principal Responsibilities:

  • Oversees the formulation, development, and/or revision of operating policies, procedures, and strategies for contract lifecycle management
  • Manages the drafting, negotiation, and approval of contract documents, including the research and resolution of contract issues, in accordance with corporate policies and legal requirements
  • Manages all administrative tasks related to contract execution, including the routing, signing, scanning, and filing of contract documents
  • Provides authoritative guidance to internal business teams and contract subordinates on corporate goals and objectives relating to contract activity
  • Facilitates training sessions to ensure work product across internal business teams and contract subordinates is in compliance with corporate contracting standards
  • Develops contract subordinates to assume more complex contract activity
  • Reviews work output of contract subordinates for completeness and accuracy (quality), reassigns tasks as needed to accommodate volume fluctuations (quantity), and tracks both metrics against business needs, reporting status and key issues to Director of Contracts
  • Partners with sales staff to understand upcoming contract needs for new deals and renewals
  • Partners with legal counsel to develop, maintain, and revise contract templates and contracting guidelines to ensure uniform general terms and conditions
  • Drives continuous improvement by overseeing and participating in special projects

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, J.D. preferred

- 5+ years related experience

  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills
  • Strong line management skills, including effective delegation and prioritization
  • Ability to develop, prioritize, and accomplish goals
  • Ability to deliver and drive consistency in a team environment
  • Ability to work with varying seniority levels, including staff, other managers, and external partners
  • Ability to analyze and improve business processes
  • Knowledge of contract documents and specifications
  • Knowledge of legal requirements pertaining to contracts

LanguageLine Solutions Confidential Information

  • Experience working with a Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) system a plus
  • Proficient with online meeting and web conferencing tools
  • Proficient with MS Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Adobe Acrobat Pro

Other Duties:

Travel as required up to 10%.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Activities, duties, or responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Physical Requirements:

The employee will be working in a home office environment in which he/she must sit for extended periods of time in front of a computer as the main working tool. Use of telephone with or without a headset is required. The employee will be frequently required to see, talk, and hear. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

For U.S. Positions: Candidates must be authorized to work in the US without the need for visa sponsorship. At this time,
Teleperformance Specialized Services Companies does not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

It is also our policy to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of the employment process. raw.description:
Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!

At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we're committed to always doing the right thing. As one of the fastest-growing hospitality brands, we're all about crafting unforgettable experiences for our guests. We offer endless learning opportunities and the chance to make a lasting impact on our business, restaurants, and communities. As a member of the #ShackFam, you’ll have access to hands-on mentorship, training, and growth potential, all in a fun and inclusive environment.

Join us and Be a Part of Something Good.

Job Summary

Shake Shack is looking for a Director, Brand & Corporate Communications to help shape, share, and protect the story of one of the most loved brands in hospitality. This leader will develop and oversee integrated consumer PR and corporate communications strategies that build brand love, drive cultural
relevance, strengthen reputation, and bring Shake Shack’s purpose, food, people, and guest experiences to life. From crave-worthy menu launches and earned media moments to executive visibility, corporate storytelling, reputation management, and issues response, this role sits at the center of how Shake Shack shows up in the world.

The ideal candidate is a creative, strategic, culture-obsessed communications pro who knows how to turn business priorities into compelling stories, build strong relationships with media and external partners, and lead a high-performing team with clarity, energy, and care. This is a can’t-miss opportunity for a
modern communications leader who loves great storytelling, moves fast, thinks big, sweats the details, and wants to help write the next chapter of Shake Shack’s brand story.

Job Responsibilities and Duties
Brand Communications

  • Develop and lead consumer PR strategies that build brand love, cultural relevance, and earned media momentum for Shake Shack’s food, guest experience, campaigns, collaborations, partnerships, and brand moments.

  • Turn menu news, business priorities, guest insights, and brand initiatives into compelling stories that feel fresh and unmistakably Shake Shack.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with lifestyle, food, culture, business, and trade media, creating proactive storytelling opportunities that keep Shake Shack part of the conversation.

  • Partner closely with Brand Marketing, Culinary, Digital, Tech, Social, Operations, Development and agency partners to develop integrated communications plans that support national campaigns, partnerships and market-level priorities.

  • Oversee press materials, messaging, media outreach, seeding, events, and measurement to ensure consumer communications are creative, strategic, on-brand, and built to drive impact.

Corporate Communications

  • Develop and execute corporate communications strategies that strengthen Shake Shack’s reputation and clearly connect the company’s purpose, performance, people, and growth story for key audiences.

  • Lead corporate storytelling across earned, owned, and executive channels, including company announcements, leadership visibility, milestones, thought leadership, and business priority communications.

  • Serve as a trusted communications partner to senior leaders, helping craft clear, confident messaging for internal and external moments.

  • Support issues management and reputation response by developing messaging, scenario plans, media guidance, and stakeholder communications that protect trust in the brand.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of communications professionals, creating a culture of collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and growth while helping each team member do the best work of their career.

  • Set clear goals, priorities, and success measures for the communications team, providing ongoing coaching and feedback that helps the team focus on the highest-impact work and continue building new skills.

  • Act as a connector across the business, bringing together Brand Marketing, Culinary, Digital, Social, Operations, Development, Legal, Finance, People Resources, and senior leaders to deliver communications that are integrated and timely.

  • Lead and inspire agency partners, freelancers, and external collaborators, ensuring teams are aligned on strategy, expectations, timelines, and Shake Shack’s creative and communications standards.

Budget & Financial Management

  • Partner with the Chief Communications Officer and Finance team to manage communications budgets, agency scopes, and resource planning in a way that supports business priorities and maximizes impact.

Related Experience

  • Track record of developing and executing integrated brand and corporate communications strategies that align with business priorities, build brand love, strengthen reputation, and drive earned media impact, preferably in the restaurant or hospitality space.

  • Experience in leading, managing, and developing a team, with the ability to inspire and drive results.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use media insights, sentiment, message pull-through, reputation signals, and campaign performance data to inform strategy and measure communications impact.

  • Deep understanding of brand storytelling and reputation management, with the ability to protect and evolve Shake Shack’s voice across consumer, corporate, executive, and issues-related communications.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence and present to senior leadership and external partners.

Education or Certificate Details

  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Business, or a related field

Supervisory Experience:

7-9 years

Work Experience:

10+ years

Benefits at Shake Shack:

A work environment where you can come as you are, share your ideas, have fun, and work collaboratively:

  • Weekly Pay and Performance bonuses

  • Shake Shack Meal Discounts

  • Exclusive corporate discounts for travel, electronics, wellness, leisure activities and more

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance*

  • Employer Paid Life and Disability Insurance*

  • 401k Plan with Company Match*

  • Paid Time Off*

  • Paid Parental Leave*

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program on Day 1

  • Pre-Tax Commuter and Parking Benefits

  • Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Accounts*

  • Development and Growth Opportunities

*Eligibility criteria applies

Pay Range - $170,487.50 - $228,362.50

Click the "Apply" button above to apply for this opening.

About Us

Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best-selling author of Setting the Table. Shack Fans lined up daily, making the cart a resounding success, and donating all proceeds back to the park beautification efforts. A permanent stand was eventually built…and the rest is Shack history! With our roots in fine dining and giving back to the community, we are committed to high quality food served with a high level of hospitality. Our team members enjoy a positive work environment that is deeply committed to the philosophy that we "Stand for Something Good."

Shake Shack is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability (mental and physical), sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital, military and veteran status.

Become a part of our caring community

The Program Integrity Researcher is responsible for reviewing, documenting, and researching incoming allegations, referrals, and requests related to potential fraud, waste, and abuse. This role supports program integrity operations by creating and maintaining accurate database records, gathering relevant information through follow-up outreach, and obtaining supporting documentation such as medical records and claims data. The position requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to handle sensitive information professionally and confidentially.

Our Government Contract Requires US Citizenship for this Position

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

40% - Review incoming referrals and documentation to ensure all relevant details are captured in the case management system.

40% - Conduct follow-up calls to members, providers, internal partners, or other involved parties to verify information and gather additional details needed for research or case development

20% - Request and track medical records needed to support program integrity reviews and investigations. Request, obtain, and organize claims data for analysis and review. Support analysts, investigators, and leadership by preparing case information and documentation for further review


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma
  • Basic Computer Knowledge
  • Experience Conducting Telephone Outreach and Follow-up Conversations
  • Strong Data Entry and Documentation Skills with High Attention to Detail
  • Ability to Manage Multiple Assignments and Prioritize
  • Organizational and Time Management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Basic Medical Claims Experience
  • Experience Working with Healthcare Documentation and Databases
  • Experience in Program Integrity, Healthcare, Claims Review

Additional Information

Communication

Effectively conveys information in a clear, concise, and professional manner, both verbally and in writing. Listens actively, shares relevant information with appropriate audiences, and adjusts messaging to meet the needs of different stakeholders. Builds understanding and supports collaboration through open and respectful communication.

Attention to Detail

Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness in completing work. Carefully reviews information, identifies inconsistencies or errors, and ensures tasks, documentation, and processes are completed correctly and completely. Maintains a high standard of quality while following established requirements and procedures.

Critical Thinking

Uses logic, analysis, and sound judgment to evaluate information, solve problems, and make decisions. Identifies root causes, considers risks and alternatives, and applies facts and data to develop effective solutions. Approaches challenges thoughtfully and recommends practical next steps.

Organization

Effectively plans, prioritizes, and manages work to meet deadlines and achieve goals. Maintains orderly records, tracks multiple tasks efficiently, and uses time and resources productively. Demonstrates the ability to coordinate responsibilities in a structured and dependable manner.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$53,700 - $72,600 per year

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

raw.description:
Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Senior Consultant/Project Manager to join our State Government Practice Group, focused on serving our state Health and Human Services (HHS) agency clients. As a Senior Consultant, you will have the right mix of demonstrated project management skills and experience, exceptional organizational and self-management qualities, strong leadership and client-facing capabilities, and effective written and verbal communication skills.

You will have 4+ years of experience working with and/or for state government agencies responsible for HHS programs (e.g., Supplemental Food Assistance Program [SNAP], Temporary Assistance for Needy Families [TANF], Child Support, and Child Care), and you will be comfortable working in many different environments within state government. You will oversee BerryDunn projects teams consisting of business analysts, and technical analysts and be responsible for developing deliverables for information technology (IT) systems planning and procurement (e.g., needs assessment, requirements development, request for proposal [RFP] development), systems implementation, independent verification & validation (IV&V), quality assurance (QA)/testing, and similar IT projects.

IT and management consulting experience is preferred, and the right candidate will be comfortable working with clients on IT-related projects. Experience with business development (e.g., writing proposals) and staff development is a plus.

You will be based in one of our physical office locations or remotely, and you will report to the HHS Practice Area Lead Principal.

Travel expectations: Up to 50% travel to client sites nationwide, potential work in the US territories.

You Will

  • Lead BerryDunn projects providing services for state HHS agency clients, such as project management, IT system planning and procurement support, business process improvement/analysis, organizational and operational assessments, strategic planning, IT and data governance, workforce assessment and development, IV&V, implementation and IT solution vendor management/oversight
  • Lead and support delivery of services to clients on time and within budget, including assigning and managing staff and overseeing development of deliverables such as IT systems assessments, needs assessments, gap analyses, requirements traceability matrices (RTMs), IT solution vendor procurement documents, federal Advance Planning Documents, IV&V reports, and QA/testing documents
  • Develop project approaches and work plans, and coordinate task assignments across project team members accordingly
  • Report on project status (written and verbal)—including risks and issues—to different audiences, including client executive leadership
  • Inspire and motivate the project teams you lead, and serve as a trusted advisor to clients
  • Facilitate meetings and interviews with client stakeholders with confidence and professionalism
  • Maintain a strong focus on providing high quality services and deliverables, in adherence with BerryDunn's Consulting Quality Management Program
  • Play a role in developing staff; contribute to maintaining and building a positive, fun, and innovative HHS team culture; and participate in and/or lead training and other learning and development activities

You Have

  • A Bachelor’s degree in a technology-related field
  • A Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute
  • 4+ years of experience working with and/or for state government agencies
  • Technology-related education, experience, and/or expertise
  • Knowledge of state government HHS programs and services
  • A strong customer focus
  • Demonstrated experience leading project teams
  • Experience in and a desire to coach and mentor junior team members
  • An ability to balance strong attention to detail with a focus on the bigger picture
  • Effective project management and organizational skills, and the ability to remain calm and focused during busy or challenging times
  • Excellent written communication skills, including documenting complex issues succinctly and logically
  • Excellent verbal and presentation skills, including articulating complex issues to a variety of audiences
  • The ability to balance multiple assignments and achieve quality results in a timely manner
  • The ability to create and sustain positive working relationships with staff and diverse constituencies and to work independently as well as collaboratively
  • Microsoft (MS) Office suite skills and experience, including MS PowerPoint, Project, Visio, and Excel

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $80,000 - 135,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about agriculture and looking to grow your career with a leading agricultural solutions provider? Evergreen FS is seeking talented individuals like you to join our team and make a difference in the lives of farmers and communities we serve. If you're dedicated, innovative, and ready to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

Salary: $100,000+ plus commission

This is a REMOTE territory based position located in Southern Michigan and North Eastern Indiana PURPOSE AND SUMMARY STATEMENT

The Agronomy Account Manager is responsible for driving consultative sales of seed and crop protection products to corn and soybean producers, managing an assigned geographic territory, and delivering field-level agronomic support to row-crop producers. This is a high-autonomy, farmer-first role combining agronomic expertise with a strong commercial focus to grow the company's book of business season over season. This position operates fully remote from a home office.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for prospecting potential sub dealers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, building trust and delivering a consistent, high-quality experience throughout the sales and agronomic support cycle.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of corn and soybean grower accounts within the assigned territory, with a focus on retention and seed and crop protection wallet-share growth year over year.
  • Conduct structured agronomic consultations — from hybrid selection and seed placement to crop protection program design — to position the right products at the right time.
  • Prepare and present customized product and program proposals; negotiate pricing within established guidelines.
  • Identify and convert prospective grower accounts through networking, referrals, and field presence.

Territory Management:

  • Develop territory growth plans that identify key account opportunities, set measurable goals, and outline strategies to expand market share within the assigned geography.
  • Own an assigned geography — plan routes and call cadences to maximize face time with high-priority accounts during critical agronomic windows.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of account activity, pipeline, and competitive intelligence in the CRM.
  • Coordinate with internal operations to ensure on-time product delivery, accurate order fulfillment, and a seamless customer experience.
  • Monitor market conditions, competitor activity, and input pricing within the territory and report trends to leadership.
  • Manage territory expenses responsibly and operate within approved budget parameters.
  • Field-Level Agronomic Support
  • Make regular on-farm sales calls and deliver timely agronomic recommendations tailored to each grower's operation, cropping system, and production goals.
  • Serve as a first-call resource for growers facing agronomic challenges, providing practical solutions backed by current university and industry research.
  • Support post-harvest field evaluations to document product performance and identify continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Stay current on product registrations, label requirements, application best practices, and crop science developments.

Qualifications:

Job Description Summary

‎

The Clinical Pharmacist I supports clinical pharmacy programs by performing medication therapy review, drug utilization review, patient and provider outreach, and medication-related quality initiative support within established protocols. This job applies clinical pharmacy training to routine patient care situations.
Clinical Pharmacist I makes clinical decisions within defined scope, with close guidance from senior clinical pharmacy staff. This job builds practical experience in value-based care, medication adherence, high-risk medication review, and interdisciplinary collaboration while contributing to safe, effective, and affordable medication use.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct medication therapy reviews and targeted patient outreach for routine clinical pharmacy initiatives under established protocols.

  • Review medication-related quality care gaps, including adherence and statin-use opportunities, and support patient or provider follow-up to improve outcomes.

  • Assess prescription histories, medication lists, refill patterns, and basic drug utilization information to identify issues requiring pharmacist intervention or escalation.

  • Collaborate with providers, care managers, pharmacy technicians, and other care team members to support medication adherence, safety, affordability, and access.

  • Educate patients and caregivers on medication use, adherence barriers, affordability resources, and pharmacist-approved care plan actions within scope.

  • Document clinical assessments, outreach results, recommendations, and follow-up actions accurately in applicable systems.

  • Review pharmacy technician-collected medication histories and outreach documentation for accuracy and clinical relevance as needed.

  • Perform comprehensive utilization management reviews for Medicare Part B-covered medical drugs, including evaluation of medical necessity, alignment with FDA labeling and compendia-supported indications, prior authorization requests, step therapy protocols, and site-of-care optimization to support cost-effective, high-quality outcomes while minimizing total cost of care.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with medical directors, providers, and care management teams on Part B and Part D drug utilization trends, denial/appeal processes, and exception requests; apply evidence-based criteria and Medicare coverage determinations to ensure appropriate utilization, support Stars/HEDIS quality measures, and drive value-based care initiatives such as biosimilar adoption and transitions from hospital outpatient to lower-cost infusion settings.

  • Participate in an interdisciplinary Model of Care for Medicare Special Needs Populations.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Doctor of Pharmacy degree or other pharmacy degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy required.

  • Active, unrestricted pharmacist license in the applicable state of practice required;collaborative practice certification, or related advanced credential may be required based on patient population and business need

  • Additional state pharmacist licenses may be required based on patient population and business need or willingness to obtain as required.

  • Completion of accredited pharmacy training required; residency, managed care experience, ambulatory care experience, or value-based care experience preferred.

  • Basic knowledge of medication therapy management, drug utilization review, medication adherence, quality measures, patient counseling, and provider collaboration.

Benefits:

  • 3 weeks PTO & 8 paid holidays

  • Medical, Dental, Vision

  • Employer Paid Basic Life & Short Term Disability coverage (goes into effect after 1 year of full-time employment)

  • 401(k) with match

  • Employee Wellness

  • Other Employee Discount programs like Tickets at Work and cell phone discounts

  • Other benefits: Dependent Care FSA, Voluntary Life, Long Term Disability, Critical Illness, Pet Insurance, and more

Why Millennium?

Millennium Physician Group is one of the largest comprehensive primary care practices with healthcare providers throughout Florida.

At Millennium Physician Group, you will find an organization that focuses on family and building a strong network of people to care for the communities we serve. We are always searching for employees who have a strong customer service attitude, fantastic teamwork skills and a willing smile ready to share.

Our promise is to provide you with the tools to do your job successfully, as well as providing a team atmosphere that empowers you to seek better ways to deliver care to our patients and their families. We also promise to care for you as an individual, and help you grow in your role with Millennium Physician Group.

If you are interested in joining an organization that puts an emphasis on team work and family, then Millennium Physician Group is the right choice.

Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!

⚡ What we’re doing

We are on a mission to eliminate bottlenecks and revolutionize the food and beverage CPG supply chain by developing innovative, all-in-one software that starts with the contract manufacturer.
Contract manufacturers and contract packagers (collectively, co-packers) are facilities that have extra production capacity and provide their services for a fee to customers (brands). Co-packers play a vital role in the trillion dollar U.S. Food and Beverage (F&B) Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, providing a range of services to convert raw materials into finished goods. These facilities are responsible for blending, drying, baking, frying, forming, and milling raw materials into bottles, pouches, cans, and other packages for our favorite foods and drinks. They are vital businesses for all food and beverage brands, including the thousands of emerging food and beverage brands that lack the resources to handle manufacturing on their own.
We’re building vertical B2B SaaS for F&B manufacturers to run all aspects of their daily operations from estimating costs and ordering raw materials to tracking inventory, managing communication with food and beverage brands, and automating production tasks. Our platform consolidates fragmented software systems and streamline workflows both internally within their business, and externally as they collaborate with their brand customers.

👬 Who we are

Our founding team is no stranger to the complexities of the F&B industry. Our CEO Crawford launched coffee-focused beverage brands and began advising numerous CPG brands and manufacturers. He has lived and breathed the supply chain and manufacturing problems in the food and beverage industry as both an entrepreneur and investor. Our CTO Soheil has 6+ years of experience as a senior software engineer and tech lead at Amazon AWS and Google, across the full stack of software development and scaling and leading engineering teams. And, we're not alone.
We've raised $1M from Bienville Capital and have a team of advisors ranging from industry veterans and consultants.

As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Actuarial Associate, Excess Casualty Pricing and Modeling - REMOTE

Nationwide’s Excess Casualty Lines team is hiring a Pricing Modeler to help shape sophisticated insurance pricing and deliver insights that influence business decisions. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong technical skills and either a solid actuarial foundation, Excess Casualty insurance knowledge, or both.

In this position, you will work at the intersection of pricing strategy, actuarial thinking, and predictive analytics. You will partner closely with teammates and business partners to build, enhance, and refine excess casualty insurance pricing. You will also have the opportunity to work across teams on a variety of projects, expand your technical toolkit, and deepen your understanding of how pricing drives real business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a technical expert in actuarial methodologies, conducting complex analyses and providing high-level consultation.

  • Build and maintain business relationships, leading pricing and product initiatives.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to deliver actionable, data-driven insights that inform strategic decisions

Highly Preferred Qualifications:

  • A minimum of five years of actuarial experience.

  • ACAS certification and working towards FCAS or recently attained FCAS.

  • Proficiency in Python, R, Power BI, Databricks, SQL, analytical software, and programming languages.

  • Experience in leading cross-functional teams and developing strategic pricing plans.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently.

This role can be staffed fully remote.

Job Description Summary

Do you have the desire to analyze data and perform groundbreaking research to drive business outcomes? Nationwide has been using data to serve our members and drive business outcomes for almost 100 years. Our industry-leading workforce adopts an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. Our Risk Analytics Researchers play a key role in harnessing the power of data to deliver business results. Specifically, they are responsible for modeling sophisticated problems, discovering insights and identifying business opportunities from data using a variety of techniques from mathematics, actuarial studies, statistics, data science and financial engineering.

As a Consultant, you’ll work on projects associated with the design, development, and application of unique risk models. You’ll need a basic understanding of broad business objectives and will work with business partners across the finance organization to develop solutions to pressing business needs. We’ll count on you to be a subject matter authority in Nationwide’s risks. It’s imperative that you are fully proficient with basic and sophisticated mathematical, statistical and analytical techniques associated with risk modeling.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Researches and implements financial engineering, data science and statistical techniques for risk management and business applications.

  • Completes regular testing of risk limits to provide distinct management guidance on asset allocation, risk transfer and product growth decisions.

  • Owns complex quantitative modeling processes and philosophies. Identifies industry standards to understand if models are working as intended.

  • Collaborates to ensure that consistent model assumptions, processes and outputs are well understood and that modeling standard methodologies are upheld.

  • Reviews and analyzes model output to identify model limitations and their impact. Provides corrective quantitative methods.

  • Crafts and updates model documentation for business continuity purposes.

  • Collaborates to develop creative solutions to business problems.

  • Acts as the technology owner for Risk Analytics.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Risk/Actuarial leader.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies in finance, accounting, economics, statistics, mathematics or related subject area required. Graduate-level studies in a related field with advanced degree highly desirable.

License/Certification/Designation: Progress toward FCAS, FSA, CQF, CFA or similar preferred.

Experience: Typically, five or more years of related work experience in financial risk modeling or actuarial functions.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Working knowledge of machine learning, stochastic processes, Monte Carlo simulations, sampling methods and other statistical techniques applicable to specialized risk modeling. Prefer mathematical knowledge of specialized risk models such as those used in hedging, economic scenario generation, catastrophe, credit risk, etc. Solid understanding of risk management operations such as asset-liability management, portfolio risk assessment, hedging, etc. Proficient written and verbal communication skills. Intermediate proficiency with Excel and common statistical software such as R, SAS, Python, or MATLAB.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment.

The individual in this role will work as an Oklahoma-based, primarily telephonic care manager, assessing and evaluating enrollees' needs and requirements to achieve or maintain optimal wellness by guiding enrollees/families towards and facilitating interaction with appropriate resources for their care and wellbeing. The individual in this role will work in collaboration with the interdisciplinary care management team. This team includes community health workers, housing support specialists, SDOH coordinators, and care management support assistants. The Care Manager, Telephonic Behavioral Health Nurse work assignments are varied but will focus on those enrollees with primarily behavioral health needs. The Care Manager, Behavioral Telephonic Nurse will utilize clinical expertise and experience to determine when face-to-face enrollee support is required. The Care Manager will engage the appropriate members of the care management team and/or coordinate in-person meetings between the care manager and the enrollee. This team-based approach is designed to ensure enrollees receive holistic person-centered care. Work assignments for this role are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

The goal is achieved by guiding members/families toward the appropriate resources for the care and overall wellbeing of the member.
  • Ensure member is progressing towards desired outcomes by monitoring care through assessments and/or evaluations.
