About Pear Suite

Pear Suite is an early-stage digital health company building software for community-based care. Our care navigation platform equips community health workers, doulas, care navigators, and the organizations that support them with tools to collect, visualize, and act on social care and community health data. We help community-based organizations, health systems, and government-funded programs deliver more coordinated, person-centered care.

Why Pear Suite?

We’re a mission-driven team committed to health equity and innovation in community-based care. You’ll thrive here if you’re eager to take initiative, value autonomy, and enjoy building structure where none exists. Join us to build scalable, human-centered technology that empowers frontline workers and improves lives across the U.S.

About the role

Community-based care is undergoing a structural shift. Across Medicaid, Medicare, managed care, and community health programs, more funding—and more accountability—is moving toward the teams closest to patients. Pear Suite is building the software infrastructure that helps organizations operationalize that work.

We’re hiring an Account Executive to own full-cycle sales across the organizations leading this shift, including community-based organizations, health systems, federally qualified health centers, and county and government-funded community health programs.

You’ll build pipeline, run discovery, deliver tailored demonstrations, and close your own book of business. You’ll work closely with the Head of Partnerships and contribute to Pear Suite’s go-to-market strategy, territory approach, and sales playbook.

What you'll do

Build and manage pipeline

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop target accounts based on buyer readiness, market developments, policy changes, funding opportunities, and organizational need.
  • Build a portion of your own pipeline through targeted outbound, relationships, industry events, and market-driven account development.

Lead the sales process

  • Run structured discovery to understand buyer priorities, workflows, decision criteria, and urgency.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect Pear Suite to each buyer’s operational, financial, and care-delivery goals.
  • Qualify opportunities rigorously and build momentum across multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

Close and transition business

  • Own the commercial process from solution scoping and proposal development through negotiation and contract execution.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders to address product, technical, security, procurement, and contracting requirements.
  • Transition closed accounts cleanly to implementation and customer success.

Contribute to our market approach

  • Bring customer feedback, market intelligence, and product gaps back to company leadership.
  • Contribute feedback to territory plans, outbound playbooks, messaging, and sales collateral.
  • Represent Pear Suite at industry events and participate in deal reviews and shared best practices.

What You Bring

Minimum qualifications

  • At least 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in healthcare
  • Experience owning the full sales cycle and navigating multi-stakeholder deals
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup environment
  • Fluency using AI tools for research, outreach, deal preparation, and writing.

Additional strengths

  • Experience with community-based organizations, health systems, health plans, FQHCs, public health agencies, government-funded programs, or tribal health organizations.
  • Strong understanding and familiarity with healthcare policy and landscape
  • Experience selling workflow software, case management platforms, or adjacent operational systems.

Personal Qualities

  • Authentic passion for community health and health equity
  • High emotional intelligence and cultural sensitivity
  • Results-driven while maintaining community-first approach
  • Resilience and adaptability in evolving conditions

What to Expect in the Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to reflect the real work of the role. Expect practical, hands-on stages, including:

  • A written account research and prioritization exercise.
  • A mock discovery call and product demo against a defined persona.

Travel Expectations

  • Up to 30% travel
  • Mix of day trips and overnight travel for key conferences and strategic meetings
  • Company covers all travel expenses
  • Flexible scheduling around community events and family commitments

Benefits and Perks

  • A mission driven culture that values innovation, collaboration and growth
  • Equity: participation in an early-stage company
  • Fully Remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Comprehensive Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health and Wellness Stipend
  • Tech Stipend
  • Co-working Stipend
  • Education and professional development allowance ($1,500 annually)
  • Home office setup stipend

Compensation

  • The base compensation range for this position is $77,000 - $87,000
    Based on experience and regional market factors
  • On Target Earnings: $140,000 – $160,000

Compensation Range Disclosure

Pear Suite posts broad salary bands to support pay transparency. The range listed above represents the full compensation band for this role.

While the full band is shown, actual offers within this band are based on a candidate's experience, skills, and internal pay equity. Only a small number of candidates, typically those with highly specialized and directly relevant experience, are placed near the top of the range. Most new hires will fall below the top of the band to allow for long-term progression and growth within the role.

Pear Suite is a fully remote organization so compensation may be adjusted upward for candidates residing in higher-cost labor markets. These geographic adjustments are not reflected in the posted range.

Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!
THE COMPANY
Blended Technologies is bringing modern SaaS to the wine industry. Our products will give winemakers the tools to manage all aspects of the winemaking process from grape to bottle, and will allow winery owners to optimize their business with tailored workflows, inventory tracking, tasting room management, direct-to-consumer sales, and CRM. We help owners and winemakers spend less time on tax and compliance paperwork and more time making great wine and keeping customers happy.
We are a fully-funded seed-stage startup rounding out our initial engineering team that is conceiving, designing, building, and bringing our product to market. We are offering competitive salary and benefits as well as single-digit-employee-number equity.
THE ROLE
Being one of the first engineering hires at a startup is a special thing – you’ll never have a greater impact, you’ll never have more opportunity, you’ll never get a bigger piece of the pie, and you’ll never have more fun. This position reports directly to an experienced CTO with decades of experience at Google, Netflix, Apple, Twilio and other tech-focused companies.
We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to help design and build our service from the ground up. You should have built big things before, have opinions about what works and what doesn’t, and can work independently on even bigger things. There isn’t always going to be a clear map that explains how to get where we want to go, so you should be comfortable trying to understand our customer needs really well, be given some UI sketches, a data schema, and coworkers to collaborate with, and be excited to figure out the rest from there.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience at 2-3+ tech-focused companies
  • Expert knowledge of React/TypeScript
  • Expert knowledge of HTML/CSS
  • Solid grasp of UX design fundamentals and the ability to translate an idea into reasonable basic UI

The more experience with any/all of these, the better:

  • GraphQL
  • Chakra or another UI component toolkit
  • React Native
  • Solid knowledge of HTTP protocol
  • Even more UX design skills than mentioned above
  • Writing GraphQL resolvers on the backend
  • MongoDB
  • AWS Cognito/Lambda/DocumentDB/API Gateway/CloudFormation
  • Writing good technical documentation
  • Working knowledge of managed cloud-service software development, esp. AWS

Overview

Carenet Health is not authorized to hire in certain states due to internal business considerations: IL, AK, CA, MA, MI, MN, NY, NV, NJ, OR, RI, WA, WV, HI, CT, DE, VT, Puerto Rico

Start date: 10/12/2026

Are you...? 

Looking for a registered nurse position that is challenging, will keep your clinical skills sharp, but being doing so from the comfort of home.

Compassion-driven, self-motivated, high-performing registered nurse.

Your critical thinking and clinical skills are top-notch.

Ready for a fast-paced position where you interact with patients through innovative channels, while keeping your clinical abilities sharp.

Want to work for an organization poised for unprecedented growth—that offers work-from-home options

Then we should talk.

Compensation

At Carenet Health, we value the expertise and dedication of our team members, and we are committed to offering an appealing compensation package. The wage for the Bilingual Care Advisor is $35.50 per hour.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • A 401(k) plan with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Employee wellness programs
  • Career development opportunities

Responsibilities

Carenet Healthcare Services is seeking RNs (Registered Nurses) to join our team of talented professionals who provide telehealth and virtual care clinical triage assessments, health education and other services to diverse populations of patients and health plan members.

At Carenet Health, our nurses play an important role in helping healthcare consumers live their healthiest lives. You may not know our name, but odds are, our nurses or clinical staff have connected with you or someone you know as a trusted, behind-the-scenes partner for our clients—250+ of the nation’s premier health plans, health systems and their partners.

About 50,000 times a day, our compassion-focused teams guide people via phone, video, chat and other channels to high-quality and cost-effective care, coach them to improved wellness, and educate them about their healthcare resources and costs.

Our nurses and clinical staff support patients across the U.S. and around the world. Our fast-paced positions offer innovative work-at-home capabilities, plus the opportunity to keep your clinical skills sharp and have meaningful interactions with patients in a less physically demanding setting than a traditional clinical environment.

We take great pride in our disciplined, evidence-based protocols and individual care approach. Our most effective clinical team members combine clinical expertise, critical thinking and the ability to develop a virtual, meaningful rapport in an empathetic way

By focusing on one patient at a time, you’ll leverage your clinical expertise, quick thinking and problem-solving skills to make a difference in thousands of lives every year.

Is this you? 

Bring empathy and a passion for evidence-based care to all you do.

Multitasking and attention to detail are your superpowers.

You have a strong clinical background and believe part of your job as an RN is to advocate for your patients.

You roll with the punches on any given day, with any given interaction, and never lose sight of the need to use your stellar interpersonal and quick assessment skills.

You respect different cultures and know that rule-following is essential to your personal integrity and your employer’s quality compliance.

 A typical week in the life of this position:

Work independently to make clinical decisions on routine patient care matters (at your license level)

Provide patient-focused care and guidance on the phone or online, including accurately assessing needs, delivering or directing to the appropriate level of care, identifying potential health problems and influencing people to make better health decisions

Communicate with our organization’s clients as needed and other team members, verbally and digitally

Monitor your own performance with dashboard metrics and look for ways to improve

Participate in coaching sessions to improve performance

Document all patient/member interactions via management software

For eight consecutive years, Inc. Magazine has named Carenet as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. You may not know our name, but odds are, we have connected with you or someone you know as a trusted, behind-the-scenes partner for our clients.

What’s important to us?

Being an integrity-driven organization that can truly change people’s lives

Serving others joyfully and individually—we’re driven by the power of personal connection

Pioneering next-generation healthcare consumer and clinical engagement experiences

An entrepreneurial mindset

A work/life balance

Qualifications

What’s required:

If you can meet these position requirements below, please complete the following APPLICATION NEXT STEPS
  • Complete our online assessments (please set aside at least 30 minutes)
  • Must complete the assessment within 24-48 hours before the exam link expires. Assessment link will be available as soon as you have successfully complete your application.

    • A min of 3 years as a Registered Nurse with recent direct patient care experience; Three (3) years preferred in a high acuity level i.e. ICU, CC, ER, med-surg, telemetry, and or Tele - Health, Telephonic Triage.

    Must currently reside and have a Multi-State (compact) unrestricted RN license in one of the following states: AL, AR, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, ME, MS, MO, MT, NE, NM, NC, ND, NH, OK, SC, SD, TN, TX, VA, WI, WY

    Ability to become licensed in additional states as required.

    must be bilingual in English and Spanish.

    Minimum of an associate's degree from a two-year technical college or technical school, or diploma nursing program; Bachelor's degree preferred

    More important information:

    Full-time positions available (36-40 hours per week)

    Your schedule will include at least two weekend days every two weeks. Differential pay may be earned for certain shifts.

    Training is 2-4 weeks, with the first two weeks during daytime hours. 100% Attendance is required. Training is done in a virtual, interactive classroom setting.

    For work-from-home positions, your home office must meet certain certification requirements that would be explained to you during the interview process.

As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Actuarial Senior Associate, Excess Casualty Pricing - REMOTE

About Us: Join Nationwide, a leader in the insurance industry, where innovation meets expertise. We are seeking a highly skilled Actuarial Senior Consultant to join our dynamic team. This role offers the opportunity to work with state-of-the-art tools and methodologies in a collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a technical expert in actuarial methodologies, conducting complex analyses and providing high-level consultation.

  • Lead cross-functional peer reviews and develop comprehensive work plans.

  • Build and maintain business relationships, leading onboarding and training initiatives.

  • Document actuarial models and maintain detailed records of methodologies and assumptions.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to deliver actionable, data-driven insights that inform strategic decisions

Highly Preferred Qualifications:

  • A minimum of five years of actuarial experience.

  • ACAS certification and working towards FCAS or recently attained FCAS.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, analytical software, and programming languages.

  • Experience in leading cross-functional teams and developing strategic work plans.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently.

This role can be staffed fully remote.

Job Description Summary

Our Property and Casualty (P&C) Actuarial team members have opportunities to use state-of-the-art tools, are encouraged to innovate and learn to master actuarial methodologies. If this sounds like a place you could thrive, then we want to know more about you!

As an Actuarial Sr Consultant, you’ll need to have detailed familiarity with business operations, systems, and actuarial methodologies. We’ll count on you to be adept at complex actuarial techniques and work independently to combine advanced actuarial and business knowledge to provide high-level analysis. Additionally, you’ll have expertise to provide consultation and recommendations on deliverables and maintain detailed documentation of actuarial models and analyses. You’ll work independently and may lead others.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a technical expert of actuarial methodologies allowing the ability to source and manipulate data within standard requirements.

  • Conducts complex analyses, adhering to actuarial standards, by selecting appropriate data sources, making assumptions, recognizing considerations, and developing recommendations. Resolves unreasonable results/non-optimal solutions using experience and professional judgment. Begins using results to influence decisions at a higher level.

  • Accurately documents assumptions, methods, sources, and considerations in an organized fashion.

  • Prepares and presents actuarial findings and documents that are suitable for technical and non-technical audiences at the senior Actuarial leadership level. May professionally represent company's position with regulators, auditors, and external vendors. May negotiate within defined parameters.

  • Develops cross functional work plans and ensures accurate work product is delivered.

  • Leads cross functional peer reviews to increase collaboration, ensure quality work, and drive innovation.

  • Builds business relationships and leads cross functional communication with team members, customers, and business partners.

  • Leads onboarding and training for new associates on standard work processes. Assists in creating new training materials.

  • Applies data mining techniques used to identify new relationships in data and make recommendations based on findings. Has expert ability or knowledge of modeling, validation, and predictive modeling. Explores the use of new software packages and makes recommendations.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to an Actuarial, Analytics, or Risk Management leader.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science or similar background requiring modeling, programming or quantitative analysis.

License/Certification/Designation: Generally attained ACAS and is working towards FCAS or recently attained FCAS. PLEASE REFER TO THE NATIONWIDE PC INSURANCE COMPANY ACTUARIAL STUDENT PROGRAM FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.

Experience: Generally, six or more years of actuarial experience.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Detailed knowledge of actuarial business functions, statistical methods of analysis, actuarial models, actuarial software and databases. Proficient in Microsoft Office products, analytical software and programming languages. Should have basic competencies including command skills, strategic agility, delegation, motivating others, business perspective and accounting. Should have highly-developed competencies in business understanding, problem solving, customer focus, dealing with ambiguity, drive for results, and learning ability.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment.

We’re excited you’re interested in a career at COUNTRY as we strive toward our vision - to enrich lives in the communities we serve. Our footprint spans coast to coast. But more important than where we operate, is the people who do the work. Apply today to help our organization grow and make a difference for our clients.

About the role

Evaluates, prices, and selects profitable reinsurance business that aligns with COUNTRY’s overall reinsurance strategy. Assesses cedent quality and exposure accumulations, while maintaining disciplined underwriting standards. Develops innovative methods to gain actionable insights from reinsurance portfolios, enabling better risk management decisions.

How does this role make an impact?

  • Evaluates cedent submissions, exposure data, modeling results, and historical losses to assess risk quality and determine appropriate terms, conditions, and coverage structures.

  • Develops, sustains, and enhances relationships with brokers and clients, gaining a thorough understanding of client portfolios, and advising on risk acceptability and treaty terms.

  • Develops technical pricing using actuarial methods and catastrophe models; assesses accumulation impacts; and contributes to portfolio balance, profitability targets, and cycle management strategies.

  • Structures treaty and/or facultative reinsurance solutions and leads negotiations with brokers and cedents to achieve mutually beneficial terms while adhering to underwriting guidelines.

  • Conducts qualitative and quantitative reviews of cedent underwriting practices, financial strength, and data quality; ensures files meet documentation, regulatory, and internal governance standards.

  • Partners cross‑functionally with various internal stakeholders to validate assumptions, refine pricing, clarify contract wording, and support deal execution.

  • Monitors market trends, coverage developments, and underwriting results to inform pricing, guidelines, and portfolio strategy; contributes to process improvements and tool enhancements.

  • Maintains accurate pipeline, referral, and bound records; produces underwriting summaries and performance reports; and supports internal audits, regulatory requests, and compliance reviews.

Do you have what we're looking for?

  • Typically requires 7+ years of relevant experience or a combination of related experience, education and training.

  • Continuing education in insurance certification programs (CPCU, ARe) preferred.

  • Up to 20% travel required in this position.

$113,200-$155,650

Incentive Pay:

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for a Short-Term Incentive plan.

Why work with us?

Our employees and representatives serve nearly one million households with our diverse range of personal and business insurance products as well as retirement and investment services. We build relationships and work together to create a stronger, more secure future for our clients and our communities. We’re a big company, yet small enough you can make an impact and won’t get lost in the shuffle. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and grow throughout your career, either within this role or by exploring other areas of our business.

You’ll be able to take advantage of our benefits package, which includes insurance benefits (medical, dental, vision, disability, and life), 401(k) with company match.

raw.description:
The Principal, IT Software Engineer 1 is a senior technical authority responsible for setting architectural direction and driving end-to-end solution design across multiple teams and complex, interdependent systems. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, shaping technical strategy, influencing organizational engineering standards, and serving as a key advisor to engineering leadership on platform direction, technical risk, and long-range planning. The Principal Engineer is a recognized subject matter expert who elevates the capability of the broader engineering organization through mentorship, technical governance, and thought leadership, while directly resolving the most ambiguous and highest-impact technical problems facing the business. This pivotal role is responsible for driving the technical design, implementation, and reliability of our next-generation Customer Experience (CX) orchestration platforms, centered on AWS, Genesys Cloud, and Salesforce.

Here’s what you’ll do:

  • Architects and delivers highly complex, cross-system solutions, proactively identifying and resolving dependencies, risks, and technical debt across multiple teams and platforms.
  • Sets technical direction and establishes architectural standards, patterns, and best practices adopted across the engineering organization.
  • Lead development of data pathways between internal and external systems, especially with integration to CRM, AI Platforms, and APIs.
  • Leads and facilitates architectural review boards, design reviews, and technical governance forums, ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture and long-term technology strategy.
  • Drives multi-PI (Program Increment) and multi-quarter technical roadmaps, translating business strategy into actionable engineering initiatives and sequencing work across teams.
  • Serves as the primary technical escalation point for the most complex, ambiguous, or high-risk problems, often those without established precedent or playbook.
  • Mentors and coaches senior engineers, tech leads, and managers, building organizational depth in technical decision-making, system design, and engineering craftsmanship.
  • Champions engineering excellence by defining and promoting best practices, coding standards, tooling strategy, and quality processes across the development community.
  • Proactively identifies systemic risks (technical, operational, and organizational) and partners with leadership to shape mitigation strategies and influence prioritization.
  • Represents engineering in cross-functional strategic discussions, influencing product, platform, and infrastructure decisions at an organizational level.
  • Evaluates emerging technologies and industry trends, making recommendations on adoption that materially affect the technology roadmap.
  • Leads technical due diligence for major initiatives, including build-vs-buy decisions, platform migrations, and large-scale re-architecture efforts.
  • Drives resolution of critical production issues requiring deep system knowledge and cross-team coordination.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree a plus.
  • 3 – 5 years of progressive software engineering experience, including significant experience in senior/lead technical roles with at least 2 years focused on high-scale Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), CX enterprise software or Field Services enterprise software.
  • Extensive experience designing and building reliable workflows and integrations in major CRMs, specifically Salesforce.
  • Experience in AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EC2, SQS, Kinesis) and proven production experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience working with REST and SOAP based web-services preferred.
  • Recognized subject matter expert with deep, broad technical expertise across software engineering, system design, and architecture.
  • Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering large-scale, distributed, and highly available systems.
  • Proven ability to influence technical direction and decision-making at an organizational (not just team) level.
  • Strong expertise in agile methodologies, SAFe/PI planning, and scaled agile delivery models.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence; able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring and developing engineering talent, including senior engineers and tech leads.
  • Experience driving enterprise architecture standards, technology governance, or engineering best-practice initiatives.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical strategy to organizational and business outcomes.

raw.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Field Medical Outcomes (FMO) Business Unit Lead is responsible for the leadership, execution, and coordination of an FMO business unit spanning multiple therapeutic areas. As a leader of leaders, this role manages and develops a team of FMO Team Leaders, ensuring alignment of people, priorities, and resources with U.S. Medical Affairs strategies and business unit objectives. The FMO Business Unit Lead partners cross-functionally with U.S. Medical Affairs, Global Medical Affairs, Payer Account Medical, Medical Outcomes & Analytics, Commercial leadership, and FMO and Medical Affairs leaders to develop and execute customer-centric medical strategies that support business unit goals while ensuring compliance with Pfizer and external policies, guidelines, and regulations.

As a member of the FMO Lead Leadership Team, the FMO Business Unit Lead helps shape the vision, strategic direction, and implementation of cross-functional customer engagement across the business unit. The role has direct people management responsibility for FMO Team Leaders whose teams deliver medical outcomes support through health care economic information (HCEI), real-world evidence (RWE), population health insights, customer collaborations, evidence generation activities, and data-driven approaches that address the needs of organized customers and healthcare decision-makers. The role also partners with Commercial Group Leads to align FMO activities with business priorities while maintaining appropriate medical governance, compliance, and reporting standards.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

Personnel Management

  • Lead, manage, develop, and coach Field Medical Outcomes Team Leaders across the business unit spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
  • Guide work prioritization and resource allocation across Team Leaders and authorize team-related expenditures, including travel, training, supplies, and other business expenses.
  • Ensure appropriate colleague deployment and account prioritization based on business unit priorities.
  • Retain key talent within the FMO organization and contribute to the identification, selection, and development of Team Leaders and colleagues.
  • Develop and maintain a high-performing culture across the leadership team and broader FMO organization.
  • Manage performance reviews, salary planning, promotions, colleague development, retention, engagement, and conflict resolution in partnership with People Experience.
  • Conduct supervisory field days with colleagues to support development, coaching, and alignment across the business unit.

Strategy and Business Planning

  • Help shape and execute medical plans aligned with U.S. Medical Affairs strategies and objectives across the business unit's therapeutic areas.
  • Drive strategic planning activities for the assigned business unit.
  • Ensure alignment with the medical content approval process and timely approval of medical content in accordance with Pfizer policies and SOPs.
  • Integrate customer insights into national tools, resources, programs, and strategic initiatives through cross-functional and cross-business-unit collaboration.
  • Represent the Field Medical Outcomes Lead on teams across Pfizer U.S., Global, and other business units to support Field Medical Governance and strategic initiatives.
  • Serve in leadership roles on internal workstreams and committees where strategic decisions are developed and executed.
  • Collaborate compliantly with HQ Medical Affairs, FMO leaders and colleagues, Medical Affairs colleagues, and Commercial partners to shape and implement customer-centric medical strategies.
  • Partner with Commercial Group Leads to align FMO activities, resource planning, reporting, and operational priorities across the business unit while maintaining appropriate medical governance and compliance standards.

Operational Management

  • Maintain current knowledge of FDA regulations and other requirements impacting interactions with healthcare professionals and organized customers.
  • Anticipate, adopt, and lead teams in effectively leveraging evolving digital capabilities that enhance medical communications and customer engagement.
  • Champion the adoption of innovative technologies, digital solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities that enhance team efficiency, customer engagement, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Lead adaptation to changes in the regional and national healthcare landscape.
  • Maintain strong market and customer knowledge and stay informed on scientific and medical literature relevant to the business unit's therapeutic areas.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable Pfizer SOPs, policies, and guidance documents.
  • Ensure Field Medical Outcomes Team Leaders' activities are conducted and documented in compliance with internal and external policies, guidelines, and regulations and that required training is completed on time.
  • Ensure direct reports and their teams provide objective, scientifically sound medical information regarding Pfizer products and disease states using pharmacoeconomic models, outcomes tools, and data analytics.
  • Participate in budget planning activities with the Field Medical Outcomes Lead.
  • Manage and oversee administrative and project management support resources across the business unit.
  • Ensure effective, compliant communication and collaboration among HQ Medical Affairs, FMO leaders and colleagues, Commercial partners, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the Medical Governance team to support organizational priorities and compliance.
  • Demonstrate accountability and decision-making with alliance partners and external collaborators that impact the broader organization.
  • Effectively communicate and advocate for the value of FMO colleagues with internal and external stakeholders.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a health science required.
  • PharmD, PhD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree (e.g., Doctor of Nursing Practice, Doctor of Physical Therapy) highly preferred.
  • 12+ years of relevant experience required with a Bachelor's degree, 10+ years of relevant experience with an MBA/MS, or 7+ years of relevant experience with a PharmD, PhD, JD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree.
  • Previous Pfizer or other relevant FMO management experience as a direct line manager required.
  • Significant demonstrated leadership skills in a matrixed environment required.

Skills

  • Demonstrate a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities, including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes, and create business impact.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire field medical professionals around a compelling vision for success, embodying Pfizer's Core Values of Equity, Courage, Joy, and Excellence.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with strong self-awareness.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, develop, and lead a team in a complex, changing environment focused on generating a positive medical customer experience.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability and interest to manage and lead a diverse team of geographically dispersed Team Leaders and professionals across the U.S.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrating flexibility and organizational awareness, and adapting to changes within short timeframes.
  • Decisive, with the ability to exercise good judgment; organized and able to prioritize a significant volume of projects and a large workload.
  • Ability to manage resources, programs, and multiple projects developed in a remote environment while demonstrating excellent judgment in a continuous improvement environment.
  • Rapidly adopt and utilize new digital technology and other resources with medical customers and record medical interactions (e.g., iPad, OneMed, Teams, on-demand video-conferencing).
  • Work within a matrixed, multi-disciplinary team to foster strong Pfizer/customer professional relationships aligned with Pfizer Medical objectives.
  • Effectively manage through and lead change in an evolving external healthcare environment; demonstrate change agility and flexibility to new opportunities (e.g., new therapeutic areas) and organizational change.
  • Problem-solve and network enterprise-wide as appropriate to identify solutions.
  • Maintain self-awareness and continually choose behaviors and responses based on their impact on one's own and others' performance and engagement.
  • Be a self-starter, accountable, with a sense of urgency in delivering results that have medical impact and yield a positive customer experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with internal/external SOPs, rules, and regulations governing Pfizer/customer interactions and relationships.
  • Expertise or experience within the business unit's designated therapeutic area(s) is highly desirable.
  • Previous FMO experience or broader Field Medical experience.

Other Job Details:

Last Date to Apply for Job: October 11th, 2026

Additional Location Information: US - remote

Eligible for Relocation Package: No

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $254,100.00 to $423,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 25.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States.This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer.

U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future.

Sunshine Act

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.

EEO & Employment Eligibility

Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States.

raw.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
raw.excerpt: We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.
raw.description:
We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

Drug Hunter is a B2B scientific intelligence platform for biotech/pharma R&D scientists that empowers them to discover the medicines of the future. We serve most of the top global biotech & pharma companies including Dow 30 and S&P500 companies. We're a mission-driven, product-focused company backed by top-tier investors and trusted by the world's leading R&D organizations.

The Director, UX and Product Design will own the overall user experience, UI/UX architecture, and product design direction across the product portfolio. This individual will be responsible for translating complex user needs and workflows into intuitive, high-quality product experiences while contributing meaningfully to product strategy. The role will work closely with Product, Engineering, Science, and Commercial teams to ensure product experiences are grounded in user evidence, aligned with business objectives, and designed to drive adoption, engagement, retention, and growth.

The Director will also establish scalable design systems and design processes and will have the opportunity to build and lead the UI/UX design organization as the company grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the overall UI/UX architecture and product design direction across the product portfolio.
  • Develop information architecture, navigation structures, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity product designs.
  • Translate complex user needs, workflows, and product requirements into intuitive, efficient, and compelling user experiences.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer discovery to inform product decisions, value propositions, and product requirement specifications.
  • Contribute to the direction of product strategy through well-structured proposals grounded in user evidence, customer needs, and product insights.
  • Drive alignment between product experiences and user workflows to increase adoption, engagement, stickiness, retention, and ultimately business growth.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing products and systematically improve usability, discoverability, consistency, and overall product quality.
  • Establish and evolve processes for design reviews, UX critique, prototyping, user validation, and design decision-making.
  • Work cross-functionally as a product leader with Science, Commercial, Product, and Engineering teams to define user requirements and validate desired outcomes from early product definition through implementation.
  • Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, Scientific/Content, and other creative teams where product and brand experiences intersect, ensuring visual brand standards are applied coherently across the customer experience.
  • Partner closely with Engineering to establish and maintain a scalable design system, including reusable components, interaction patterns, and UX principles, while maintaining a high bar for design quality and implementation fidelity.
  • Recruit, hire, manage, and mentor UI/UX and product design professionals as the Product Design organization grows.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience in product design, UX design and architecture, interaction design, or related disciplines, with significant experience designing B2B or B2X digital products.
  • Experience designing enterprise, scientific, technical, analytical, data-intensive, or workflow-oriented software or related products which serve highly specialized professional or technical users.
  • Strong proficiency with modern product design methodologies and tools, including prototyping platforms and emerging AI-enabled design and prototyping tools.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to clearly articulate and defend design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • BS, MS, or advanced degree in Design, Engineering, Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

raw.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Data & AI leads SHI's AI + Infrastructure organization within the Microsoft Services Practice. This leader brings together Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance to build and deliver connected Microsoft solutions across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Foundry, agents, data platforms, and the security and governance capabilities required to operate them responsibly.

The Senior Director runs the organization as a business, with ownership of service maturity, solution development, headcount planning, utilization, delivery quality, capacity, pipeline support, and measurable client outcomes. This role leads managers and practice leaders responsible for Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance and remains accountable for their effectiveness, development, and delivery performance.

Aligned to Microsoft's Fabric IQ and Foundry IQ investments, this role connects cloud foundation, business data, enterprise knowledge, agentic experiences, and trust. The Senior Director helps SHI move clients from isolated pilots to secure, governed, production-ready platforms and solutions while creating repeatable paths for growth.

This role sits at the center of SHI's Microsoft Services growth plan, turning Fabric IQ and Foundry IQ alignment into a working operating model that builds stronger solutions, improves delivery execution, develops talent, and creates repeatable paths for growth.

This is a remote position with a Home Office setup based in New York City, Charlotte, Chicago, Atlanta, Austin, Denver, Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Seattle.

Role Description

​

Strategic Leadership and Practice Development

  • Set and execute a unified direction for AI + Infrastructure, connecting Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance through one operating model.

  • Translate Microsoft's Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, Azure, and agent investments into a clear SHI services roadmap, capability plan, and investment agenda.

  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, handoffs, delivery standards, and quality expectations across the organization.

  • Build modular, repeatable offerings that combine cloud, data, AI, and governance capabilities around defined customer outcomes.

  • Use portfolio, pipeline, delivery, and capacity data to prioritize investments, manage tradeoffs, and improve practice health.

People Leadership Through Managers and Directors

  • Lead, coach, and develop the leaders responsible for Agentic Solutions, Cloud Platform, Data & Intelligence, and AI Security & Governance.

  • Set measurable expectations for customer experience, delivery quality, utilization, capability development, financial performance, and team health.

  • Build leadership depth through regular one-on-ones, development planning, succession planning, and clear career paths.

  • Own workforce planning across the organization, including hiring, onboarding, retention, skills development, and capacity alignment to backlog and pipeline.

  • Create a culture of shared accountability in which teams solve for the full customer outcome rather than optimize isolated technology workstreams.

Technical Direction Across Data, AI, and Security

  • Maintain a platform-aware perspective across Agent 365, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Model Context Protocol, Azure, landing zones, platform engineering, FinOps, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, data engineering, data visualization, and data readiness.

  • Embed Entra Agent ID, Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud and AI, Security Copilot, Microsoft Sentinel, and Defender XDR into AI and platform solutions where those capabilities strengthen identity, data protection, observability, governance, and threat protection.

  • Sponsor reusable reference architectures, delivery frameworks, statements of work, work breakdown structures, templates, and accelerators.

  • Rely on practice leaders and principal architects for deep technical direction while maintaining alignment across disciplines.

  • Create a practical path from assessment and platform readiness through implementation, adoption, optimization, and transition to managed services.

Delivery Excellence and Client Outcomes

  • Provide executive oversight for complex, multi-workstream engagements that span cloud, data, AI, agents, security, and governance.

  • Hold leaders accountable for scope quality, staffing readiness, delivery methodology, risk management, timelines, budgets, and customer communication.

  • Review project health, utilization, realization, margin, capacity, and quality signals and act early when performance moves off plan.

  • Protect customer trust by ensuring teams make supportable commitments, apply appropriate governance, and transition solutions into sustainable operations.

  • Serve as an executive sponsor and trusted advisor for strategic clients, connecting platform decisions to measurable business outcomes.

Business Growth and Market Development

  • Grow AI + Infrastructure services revenue by improving solution relevance, supporting strategic pursuits, expanding enterprise client relationships, and developing repeatable offers.

  • Partner with Solution Architecture, Sales, Project Management, Digital Workplace, and Managed Services to shape opportunities and deliver connected customer outcomes.

  • Manage utilization, capacity, backlog, pipeline health, and delivery performance to improve profitability and support sustainable growth.

  • Build strong relationships with Microsoft field, engineering, and partner teams to align priorities, improve co-sell execution, and strengthen SHI's market credibility.

  • Capture customer evidence, references, and measurable outcomes that support retention, expansion, and market recognition.

Executive and Cross-Functional Communication

  • Serve as an executive advisor to enterprise clients, connecting business priorities to Microsoft cloud, data, AI, agent, security, and governance strategies.

  • Communicate practice priorities, portfolio health, performance, risks, and investment needs to senior leadership, including the Vice President, Microsoft Services.

  • Run a consistent operating cadence across leaders that covers pipeline, staffing, project health, financial performance, capability development, and customer outcomes.

  • Turn operating data into decisions and actions rather than reporting activity without accountability.

  • Escalate delivery, capacity, security, compliance, and customer risks early, with clear options and recommended actions.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.

  • Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.

  • Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.

  • Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can lead strategic initiatives focused on improving the overall customer experience. Inspires and mentors others to adopt a customer-centric approach, fostering a culture of customer focus throughout the organization.

  • Results Orientation: Can inspire a culture of results-orientation across the organization, setting high standards and holding everyone accountable for achieving results.

  • Adaptability: Can drive strategic transformations, inspire others to embrace change, and foster a culture of continuous adaptation.

  • Strategic Implementation: Can lead the development and execution of comprehensive strategic plans, inspire and guide teams, and drive organizational change to achieve strategic objectives.

  • Continuous Improvement: Can lead others in identifying and implementing major improvements and proactively drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 10 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, consulting, cloud, data, AI, or related Microsoft practices.

  • 5 or more years leading managers, directors, senior technical leaders, or multi-discipline delivery organizations with accountability for people, delivery, and business performance.

  • Demonstrated success building or scaling professional services capabilities, repeatable offerings, and complex enterprise delivery motions.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Fabric, Foundry, Copilot Studio, agents, data platforms, and the identity, security, and governance services that support enterprise adoption.

  • Experience managing utilization, capacity, staffing, delivery quality, portfolio health, and financial performance.

  • Ability to engage enterprise executives, translate business priorities into technology and services roadmaps, and guide complex decisions.

  • Track record of partnering across sales, presales, project management, managed services, and technology partners to grow customer relationships.

  • Relevant certifications may include Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, Azure architecture, cybersecurity architecture, identity, or agentic AI credentials. Equivalent experience and demonstrated leadership may substitute for specific certifications.

  • Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet all of these qualifications.

Your Success at SHI

People who are successful in this role tend to demonstrate:

  • Strong ownership of a multi-discipline services organization, connecting technical direction with people leadership and business performance.

  • The ability to connect cloud, data, agents, and governance into practical solutions that clients can adopt and operate.

  • A talent development mindset that grows managers and practice leaders into confident, accountable leaders.

  • Comfort using portfolio and delivery data to guide staffing, coaching, investment, and escalation decisions.

  • Strong collaboration across Solution Architecture, Delivery, Project Management, Digital Workplace, Managed Services, Sales, and Microsoft.

  • A genuine commitment to customer experience, delivery quality, security, compliance, and the long-term growth of SHI's Microsoft Services practice.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with executives, managers, technical leaders, sales teams, and customer stakeholders.

  • Ability to travel to support client engagements, Microsoft alignment, leadership meetings, and internal enablement, up to 25%.

  • Commitment to continuous learning as Microsoft cloud, data, AI, agent, and security platforms evolve.

  • Strong ethical standards with disciplined attention to privacy, governance, compliance, security, and responsible AI.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $225,000 - $325,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

raw.description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Tech Lead to drive our 0-1 product development at Toters. This is a unique opportunity to shape a product from the ground up, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a high-impact solution in the Middle East market. The ideal candidate will have a blend of deep technical expertise, a proven track record in system design and architecture, and 0-1 experience to move fast and drive innovation in an ambiguous environment.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of new 0-1 products focusing on speed of iteration and learning while keeping scalability in mind.
  • Advise leadership on key technical roadmap and execution considerations.
  • Lead and mentor a team of backend and mobile engineers, providing guidance and direction on best practices.
  • Set coding standards, review code for quality, and advocate for scalable and secure designs.

Product Development

  • Architect and implement scalable backend solutions, leveraging microservices, event-driven, and serverless designs.
  • Develop and optimize RESTful APIs and backend systems for high performance and reliability, ensuring seamless integration with internal and external systems.

Project Management

  • Break down complex projects into manageable tasks and ensure timely delivery.
  • Monitor progress, adjust plans as needed, and communicate updates to stakeholders.

Team Building & Collaboration

  • Participate in recruiting efforts to grow a high-performing engineering team.
  • Work closely with cross-functional partners to define requirements and drive product success.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of backend engineering experience, including technical leadership roles.
  • Proven experience in designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems.
  • Track record of launching successful 0-1 products at startups or fast-growing tech companies.
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python, Java, Node.js, Go, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of architectural principles like Microservices, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), or Event-Driven Architecture.
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and services such as EC2, ECS, Lambda, and RDS.
  • Expertise in RESTful API design, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), and caching/queuing systems like Redis.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), and DevOps practices.
  • Startup Mindset: Thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, with a focus on rapid prototyping and iterative development.
  • Customer Centric: You measure your success in terms of customer and business impact, not lines of code.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Collaboration: Strong team player, with the ability to work effectively across functions like Product and Design, and teams across the organization.

Nice to Have

  • Mobile Development: Familiarity with iOS and Android mobile app development, especially in Swift and Kotlin.
  • Team Development: Experience hiring, mentoring and developing engineers. Previous people management experience is appreciated but not required.
  • Regulatory and Compliance Awareness: familiarity with key data & privacy regulations and ensuring regulatory compliance in system design.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Company Overview:

Toters is an on-demand e-commerce and delivery platform that empowers customers to access anything in their city with unparalleled convenience. Technology drives everything we do at Toters. Our product and engineering teams work tirelessly to develop solutions that simplify customers' lives, allowing them to easily purchase and receive anything they want at their doorstep. If you're excited about working in a fast-growing startup and want to join a team transforming local shopping experiences in the Middle East, apply now.

raw.description:
When applying for roles at Tealium, please use our official careers page or LinkedIn company profile. All other sites where Tealium careers may appear may not be legitimate.

WHO WE ARE

Tealium is the trusted leader in real-time Customer Data Platforms (CDP), helping organizations unify their customer data to deliver more personalized, privacy-conscious experiences. As the demand for connected, intelligent customer engagement grows, Tealium’s leadership in CDP is translating directly into leadership in enabling enterprise AI strategies. By providing clean, consented, and actionable data, Tealium empowers its customers to accelerate the adoption of AI and machine learning, fueling smarter personalization, predictive insights, and business outcomes at scale.

More than 800 leading global brands trust Tealium to power their customer data strategies and deliver real-time, personalized experiences at scale.

Team Tealium has team members present in nearly 20 countries worldwide, serving customers across more than 30 countries. We win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. We are intentional about our WOWs (Ways of Work) culture, our investment in our team members, and how we care and connect.

With an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including Georgian, Silver Lake Waterman, Battery, and others) and deep industry experience, Tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. Today, Tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include:

  • A Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms

  • 2025 TrustRadius Award Winner: Buyer’s Choice

  • 2024 Invoca Partner Collaboration Award

  • 2024 G2 Leader in Tag Management & Enterprise Data Governance

  • Tealium Customer Data Hub achieved the Top Rated Award by TrustRadius (2024)

  • Named on Destination CRM’s 2024 Top 100 Technologies List for Sales

  • Named on the 2024 Best and Brightest in the Nation list

  • BuiltIn’s 2024 Best Place to Work

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Tealium is seeking a strategic, technically fluent, and results-driven Partner Development Director to accelerate growth across EMEA. You will own the strategy and execution for key cloud, data infrastructure, and technology partnerships, with a particular focus on ecosystems such as AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

As the most trusted technical data infrastructure platform, Tealium is focused on expanding how customers build, activate, and innovate with their data. This role will help accelerate that strategy by building the partnerships and distribution models that extend Tealium’s reach. You will identify new routes to market, strengthen strategic relationships, and develop product-led marketplace motions and listings that make it easier for customers to discover, adopt, and build with Tealium.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial instincts with meaningful technical acumen across modern data and cloud infrastructure. Most importantly, you are a builder, proactive in identifying opportunities, comfortable creating new motions where a playbook may not exist, and able to turn ideas into scalable partner strategies and measurable revenue. You will leverage partner data, market intelligence, and modern AI-enabled tools and workflows to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, improve execution, and drive better business outcomes.

This is a UK-based remote role. Candidates must be based in the United Kingdom to support our EMEA partner ecosystem and regional business needs, and must be willing and able to travel up to 50% across EMEA.

YOUR DAY TO DAY

  • Build and execute an EMEA partner strategy focused on strategic cloud and data infrastructure ecosystems, including AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, and GCP.

  • Develop and scale product-led marketplace strategies and listings that expand distribution and create new paths for customers to discover and adopt Tealium.

  • Build new partner motions from the ground up, proactively identifying opportunities across the evolving cloud, data, and AI infrastructure landscape.

  • Own the performance of strategic partnerships across pipeline, revenue, marketplace adoption, technical enablement, and joint go-to-market execution.

  • Develop compelling technical and commercial value propositions that motivate partners to integrate, build with, co-sell, and go to market with Tealium.

  • Leverage AI-enabled tools, automation, and data to identify opportunities, evaluate partner and pipeline health, improve productivity, and make faster, more informed decisions.

  • Build relationships across partner product, engineering, marketplace, sales, and executive teams to accelerate execution and revenue.

  • Collaborate closely with Tealium Sales, Solutions Consulting, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to drive aligned execution.

WHAT YOU BRING TO TEALIUM

  • 5+ years of success in enterprise technology partnerships, business development, cloud alliances, or strategic partner development.

  • Strong experience across cloud, data infrastructure, or enterprise technology ecosystems, ideally including AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP, or similar platforms.

  • Strong technical fluency across cloud architecture, data infrastructure, data orchestration, integrations, and the building blocks supporting modern AI applications.

  • Experience developing cloud marketplace or product-led distribution strategies, including marketplace listings, integrations, or co-sell motions.

  • A true builder mentality, with demonstrated success creating new partnership motions and go-to-market strategies rather than simply managing established programs.

  • Ability to engage credibly with both technical and commercial audiences, from product and engineering teams to sales leaders and senior executives.

  • Highly proactive and comfortable operating with autonomy, able to identify an opportunity, build a plan, mobilize stakeholders, and drive it through execution.

  • Experience leveraging modern tooling and AI-enabled workflows to improve partner engagement, decision-making, and operational efficiency.

  • Strong communication, strategic thinking, and collaboration skills with an ownership mindset.

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% within the region.

WAGE TRANSPARENCY

In several countries worldwide, including regions within the EMEA and APJ, employers are required or strongly encouraged to include salary ranges in job postings. While requirements vary by location, transparency is a core value at Tealium. We’re committed to providing clear and consistent compensation information to all applicants, regardless of location.

This position offers a base salary range of £ 100,000 - 130,000 GBP annually. The final offer is determined by job-related skills, experience, and qualifications. The role may also be eligible for a performance-based bonus and equity options.

WHY YOU WANT TO WORK HERE

At Tealium, we don’t just offer the ordinary, we provide the extraordinary:

  • Tealium WOWs (Ways of Work), our award winning culture is how with think, act and connect together at Tealium
  • Mosaic, our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is grounded in our mosaic of diverse perspectives and shared belonging as we live in work across the US and in nearly 20 countries
  • Tealium Cares, to promote caring in our communities, 15 hours of paid work time for volunteer activities and programs is offered annually
  • Tealium Connects (remote-first working), enabling many of us to choose where we do our best work and offering new hire stipends to assist with purchasing things we need to support a successful home office environment
  • Tealium Ownership, share in the success of Tealium by becoming an owner of Tealium beginning with new hire equity grants
  • Tealium Time, paid time-off policy to offer flexibility to take time when needed and robust leave programs, including extended paid parental leave and company holidays
  • Healium, health and wellness programs to help us be our best selves in the experiences of health, physical, mental, social, and even financial well-being and wellness
  • Tealium LIFT (Learning is Facilitated at Tealium), offering a myriad of professional development opportunities with over 6,000 courses available on demand to best-in-class manager and leadership development programs
  • Health and Related Benefits Programs, offering market competitive benefits programs
Collectively, we contribute our individual pieces (identity, experiences, heritage, backgrounds, religions, viewpoints, gender and more ) to form the mosaic of Team Tealium. It is our continuing philosophy to recruit and employ the best qualified individuals without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, and/or any other protected characteristic. Tealium does not tolerate unlawful discrimination of any kind and strives to be an inclusive and respectful workplace.
The highly relevant and differentiated positioning of Tealium’s solutions makes this a unique and rewarding career opportunity.
*Offerings vary by level and location.
